Mummy Sarcophagus

Created using long-forgotten techniques, these coffins serve not as a resting place for the honored dead, but as a magical means of creating animated mummies to serve as guardians of their hidden crypts. Although the purpose of these sarcophagi may have been to protect the treasures buried beneath the dunes, the evil that has corrupted the sands around Lut Gholein has also turned these guardians into predators.

Tips and Other Additional Information
Kill the Mummy Sarcophagus as soon as possible to prevent more Mummies from being spawned.

Mummy Sarcophagi do not drop items. You cannot steal Life or Mana from a Mummy Sarcophagus.
